Commentary.Commentary: Time for the action to begin! The Lankan openers, Dimuth Karunaratne and Pathum Nissanka make their way out to the middle. Fazalhaq Farooqi has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Afghanistan succumbed to pressure. Probably not of the decider match but against some really good bowling performances. No one showed any character to be honest and now have ended with a below-par score. They now need to pull off something more than special to get a result. Does not look so as Sri Lanka will fancy to chase it down with ease. Should be a straight forward chase unless we see Rashid Khan pull off a miracle. Stay tuned for the chase.

What an extraordinary performance from the Lankans. They delivered in this must-win game. Superb from the Lankans. Afghanistan opted to bat first but it turned out to be a disastrous decision as they were trapped in some high quality stuff bowling. Dushmantha Chameera and Lahiru Kumara started the downfall. Both bowled in tandems and with the swing on offer, they made the most of it. Dushmantha Chameera almost bowled from one side to keep the pressure on. Wanindu Hasaranga later came on and he delivered his magic, ending with three wickets.

OUT! LBW! This time it should be out! Fazalhaq Farooqi has taken the review though. A googly, full and on middle. Farooqi tries to heave but is late to get his bat across and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. UltraEdge shows no bat. Ball Tracking shows three reds. Afghanistan are bowled out for 116.

The Lankans in their own backyard were given a surprise early on as Afghanistan took the lead but the hosts came back strong with a resounding victory. The home team will fancy to win here but Afghanistan have given a tough fight and give their all in this final game. Who do you think will win? Toss and team news coming up.
